name: helious
description: Live US market data for your AI: Treasury yields and the curve regime, the economic calendar scored the second it prints, auction results with the tail, Fed rate odds, the FX and volatility boards, and the Helious feed.

interface.shortDescription: Live US market data for AI
interface.longDescription:
Helious is a US market data desk your AI can read directly. Every economic release is captured when it prints and scored against its own history, so a CPI or payrolls number arrives with the forecast, the surprise in standard deviations, and where the level sits in decades of official data. Treasury auctions come back shortly after the close with the tail, the bid-to-cover and who bought. Yields carry the curve regime and the time it last flipped.

Connect it and ChatGPT gains 25 read-only tools: Treasury yields and the whole curve, curve regime history, the official 17:00 closes, the economic calendar with scored results, every series Helious tracks in depth, auction results, Fed rate-cut and hike odds from the futures strip, the SOFR and fed funds rate path, the FOMC roster, digests of FOMC minutes and central bank speeches, the FX momentum and volatility boards, cross-asset correlations, the NASDAQ-100 board, mega-cap earnings, Strait of Hormuz tanker transits, the Helious news feed, and transcribed live events.

Each answer leads with a plain-English sentence, names Helious as the source and links the page the number lives on, so you can check it yourself. Numbers travel with their history: a 52-week range and percentile on a yield, twelve-auction averages on an auction, the rank of a print against its own series.

Helious captures these figures first-hand from the publishing source. It is a primary source, not an aggregator of other outlets.

Signing in connects your Helious account, and what each tool returns follows that account. The sign-in is OAuth and read-only: the connection cannot change your account or settings, and you can disconnect it from your account page at any time.

Helious provides market information for educational purposes. Nothing it returns is investment advice.
defaultPrompt: Use Helious to tell me what the Treasury curve is doing today.
Use Helious to show me how the last 10-year auction went.
Use Helious to list this week's economic releases with forecasts.

positive.prompt: What is the US Treasury curve doing today?
positive.expected_behavior: A sentence naming Helious, then yields by tenor, the 2s10s spread, the curve regime and when it last flipped, with a link to helious.io/rates.

positive.prompt: How did the most recent 10-year Treasury auction go?
positive.expected_behavior: The high yield, the tail against the when-issued yield, bid-to-cover against the tenor's average, the bidder split and the desk's strong, in line or weak verdict, with the auction page link.

positive.prompt: What economic releases print this week and what is forecast?
positive.expected_behavior: The week's rows with time, forecast and prior, and the actual where it has printed, with a link to helious.io/calendar.

positive.prompt: What are the odds of a Fed rate cut at the next FOMC meeting?
positive.expected_behavior: Probabilities per remaining meeting priced from fed funds futures, the implied rate after each, and the page link.

positive.prompt: How hot was the last US CPI print compared with its own history?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest CPI print, the forecast, the surprise in standard deviations and the rank against the series history, with a link to the data hub.

negative.description: No tool can trade. The assistant says Helious is read-only market data and offers the data instead of placing an order.
negative.prompt: Buy me 10 Treasury futures contracts right now.

negative.description: An out-of-range date returns an isError result naming the valid range; the assistant relays that and invents no numbers.
negative.prompt: Give me the Treasury auction results for the 7-year note sold in 1850.

negative.description: A result outside the connected plan carries a plan_limit block; the assistant relays the page it names rather than guessing a value or pointing to another provider.
negative.prompt: Show me the live NASDAQ-100 board on a free account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payment. Every tool is read-only market data.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: first directory release. 25 read-only tools over the Helious MCP server, OAuth sign-in, and every answer cites the page its number came from.
